name: Lisa Total Investigation!
source:
Meet Paul and his fiancee, Lisa!
They have exciting plans for the big day, but things take a turn for the worse.
First, there is a suspicious accident where one of their friends is killed.
Then a Scotland Yard officer recruits Paul as an undercover agent…
They become involved in an investigation that will change their relationship forever.
I guess many things can go wrong on the road to marriage!
What is certain is that Lisa’s life will never be the same.
translation:
来认识一下保罗和他的未婚妻莉萨吧！
他们原本为婚礼大喜之日制定了激动人心的计划，事态却急转直下。
先是一场可疑的意外事故夺走了他们一位好友的性命；
紧接着，一名苏格兰场警官将保罗招募为卧底特工……
两人就此卷入一场彻底改写彼此关系的调查之中。
看来在通往婚姻殿堂的路上，真是随时都可能横生枝节！
唯一可以确定的是，莉萨的人生将再也回不到从前了。
